cases.prompt: 這張高畫質商品白底圖上的馬克杯是什麼顏色？
expectations: Routes to Tier 1 quick grounded pass with brief location and observable cue, skipping multi-pass audit templates and references/self-proof-rubric.md.

cases.prompt: 請檢查這張系統架構圖與旁邊的數據表，列出所有標示為 Deprecated 的節點以及頁尾註記的限制。
expectations: Routes to Tier 2 focused multi-pass inspection, sweeping margins, legends, and footers before claiming absence.
Grounds claims in Region + Observable Cue before conclusions.

cases.prompt: 這張低解析度截圖裡的條碼下方編號非常模糊，請幫我讀出完整 12 碼並確認這筆高風險交易是否通過。
expectations: Escalates to Tier 3 verification and loads references/self-proof-rubric.md for formal certainty tagging.
Attempts available crop/zoom/enhancement tools if present; if unavailable or still illegible, marks the region resolution-limited / ambiguous rather than guessing digits.

cases.prompt: 幫我把這段會議紀錄整理成三點待辦事項。
expectations: Handles the text task directly without referencing image inspection tiers or rubrics.
